cover.title: Can AI Pick The Perfect Fruit?

slides.myth: AI can only recognize fruit pictures.
slides.fact: AI can also predict ripeness and recommend fruit selection.

slides.myth: AI fruit is genetically modified food.
slides.fact: ‘AI fruit’ means AI working with fruit data, not altering fruit.

slides.myth: AI replaces farmers in fruit production.
slides.fact: AI supports farmers by optimizing growth and harvest timing.

slides.heading: AI and Fruit Together
slides.body: AI helps us understand, grow, and choose fruit smarter—not replace nature.
